name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.74 / build 75 renames the student form to SMAPE and adds MAPE with separate company and emergency-contact fields, drafts and saved records. Both use their matching supplied images, review histories, staff notifications and approved PDF export. Legacy SMPE records and drafts retain their identifiers and history. The matching backend supports both examination types; desktop approval screens contain separate nested histories. Website guidance covers both forms. Existing chat and booking features are unchanged. No database migration, Firebase rule, SDK or signing-key change. Existing development certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation and push delivery are not verified.
